name: lastperson
title: the last person on the internet
blurb: a zoomable single-elimination bracket where every DID plays a real, deterministic, replayable match until one identity remains, then the winner seeds the next tournament. a synthetic demo roster resolves a million entrants in well under a second; an optional real mode indexes public DIDs from the relay. spec by @blindguymcsleazy.bsky.social.
